trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: The trailing edge of the right lobe exhibits irregular, low-amplitude serrations with distinct peaks near the tip. The left lobe trailing edge is partially visible with smoother, less frequent variations. The central portion of the trailing edge is occluded by water turbulence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both visible lateral margins exhibit a convex sweep trajectory, tapering progressively toward the distal tips as they emerge from the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast white circular pixel clusters are concentrated on the lateral margin and adjacent dorsal surface of the left lobe. A single high-intensity white cluster is visible at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned light-grey linear pixel disruptions are visible on the dorsal surface of the right lobe, oriented roughly parallel to the longitudinal axis of the lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization (Coronula spp.) is present on the lateral edge of the left lobe, creating a distinct three-dimensional textured profile against the dark skin.
